body:
### Summary

uv tool run goes to the internet to get the latest package, even though I have installed an older version with exclude-newer previously

`
uv tool install --exclude-newer="1 week" ty
#Resolved 1 package in 352ms
#Prepared 1 package in 3.63s
#Installed 1 package in 2ms
# + ty==0.0.65
#Installed 1 executable: ty

uv tool run ty --version
#Installed 1 package in 2ms
#ty 0.0.68
`

I don't think this is expected behaviour as per https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/cli/#uv-tool

"If the tool was previously installed, i.e., via uv tool install, the installed version will be used unless a version is requested or the --isolated flag is used."

### Platform

Ubuntu server 24.04

### Version

uv 0.12.1 / 0.12.2

### Python version

3.14.6
title: uv tool run ignoring installed version if newer available
